change_note: Official company news: the SEC's filings index (sec_filings) for every company on every stock list; company numbers (sec_xbrl) now cover every stock list too.

sources.label: Daily prices
sources.note: Split/dividend-adjusted EOD bars. Key only in the TIINGO_API_KEY Actions secret. Raw bars are never committed or published (licence); the site shows derived returns and indexed lines.

sources.label: Second price source (cross-check)
sources.note: Polygon.io free plan (five requests a minute), adjusted daily bars. Used only to check Tiingo: agreement statistics are published, never a price. Skipped until the POLYGON_API_KEY Actions secret exists.

sources.label: Accounts to follow on X
sources.note: Planned and parked: the X connector costs money. If the household turns it on, it keeps links and derived signals only, never post text, and follows only the confirmed accounts of the people we follow.

sources.label: Headlines for watchlist names
sources.note: Headlines and links only; summaries are computed, not copied.

sources.label: Company numbers (SEC XBRL)
sources.note: The SEC's free, public-domain company facts. No key: the SEC asks for a User-Agent naming the client with a contact email, kept in the SEC_USER_AGENT Actions secret. Trailing-twelve-month figures, point in time.

sources.label: Official company news (SEC filings)
sources.note: The SEC's free, public-domain filings index: each company's recent 8-K (with item codes), 6-K, 10-Q, 10-K and 20-F filings, as dated links with fixed plain titles. Same SEC_USER_AGENT secret as the company numbers; no key.

sources.label: Books and lectures
sources.note: Paraphrased principles with a citation. The repo is public: never commit source text.

sources.label: People we learn from
sources.note: Who we follow, why, and their dated public calls with a link to each source, added by hand and paraphrased. Code scores every call against the S&P 500 core from the daily closes; only percentages are published.

sources.label: Fund holdings (SEC 13F filings)
sources.note: SEC EDGAR 13F filings: free and official, US long positions only, filed up to about forty-five days after each quarter end. Not connected; the household decides before any provider is connected. Until then calls are added by hand.
